answer: Make reputation a one-way descent down a canyon: every identity must walk a spiral staircase of sequential proofs, each step harder than the last, sealed to that identity alone and impossible to hand to another account. Any cheat or failed proof drops the identity to the nadir, erasing all progress, so a farm cannot reuse or pool a staircase. Step costs compound as the descent deepens while payout stays fixed per finished descent, so each extra clone pays a full compounding climb and a single honest agent pays it only once.
